known_correctness_blockers.finding: The six-DOF beam projects each nodal principal Log(R) rotation vector onto the current chord, then arithmetically averages the projected values. Crossing a nodal +pi/-pi branch produces an approximately 180-degree element attack-angle discontinuity at a continuous physical orientation.
known_correctness_blockers.measurement_scope: Saved accepted states and branch-limit algebra verify the discontinuity. Extrapolated/piecewise-limit loads are not measured rejected coarse/half-step states; separate Eq/Ev contributions were not saved.
known_correctness_blockers.acceptance_effect: Fixed beam uses the same defective aerodynamic path. Agreement with fixed dt/2 can only be recorded as a time-step comparison within the same defective model; it must not establish algorithm correctness, physical correctness, galloping validation or paper reproduction.
